title: Work completion rate
content: Completed owned tasks divided by tasks due in the period. The metric must have a single owner, authoritative query, refresh schedule, target, warning threshold and documented limitations.

structured_data.formula_description: Completed owned tasks divided by tasks due in the period.

title: SLA compliance
content: Cases completed within the department SLA divided by completed cases. The metric must have a single owner, authoritative query, refresh schedule, target, warning threshold and documented limitations.

structured_data.formula_description: Cases completed within the department SLA divided by completed cases.

title: Rework rate
content: Cases reopened, corrected or overridden after completion divided by completed cases. The metric must have a single owner, authoritative query, refresh schedule, target, warning threshold and documented limitations.

structured_data.formula_description: Cases reopened, corrected or overridden after completion divided by completed cases.

title: Exception rate
content: Cases requiring escalation divided by cases processed; interpret with severity and policy context. The metric must have a single owner, authoritative query, refresh schedule, target, warning threshold and documented limitations.

structured_data.formula_description: Cases requiring escalation divided by cases processed; interpret with severity and policy context.

title: Automation coverage
content: Eligible cases completed through approved automation divided by eligible cases. The metric must have a single owner, authoritative query, refresh schedule, target, warning threshold and documented limitations.

structured_data.formula_description: Eligible cases completed through approved automation divided by eligible cases.

title: Evidence completeness
content: Completed cases with all mandatory evidence and audit references divided by completed cases. The metric must have a single owner, authoritative query, refresh schedule, target, warning threshold and documented limitations.

structured_data.formula_description: Completed cases with all mandatory evidence and audit references divided by completed cases.

title: Cost per completed case
content: Direct provider, model and operational cost divided by completed cases. The metric must have a single owner, authoritative query, refresh schedule, target, warning threshold and documented limitations.

structured_data.formula_description: Direct provider, model and operational cost divided by completed cases.
